description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) interface for managing Reminder entities in a Room database, including methods for inserting, updating, deleting, and querying reminders.

classes.name: ReminderDao
classes.description: Interface for database operations related to Reminder entities in the app.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new Reminder into the database, ignoring conflicts.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates existing Reminder(s) in the database.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes a Reminder by its unique ID.

methods.name: deleteByNoteId
methods.description: Deletes reminders associated with a specific note ID.

methods.name: deleteIfNoteIdIn
methods.description: Deletes reminders whose note IDs are in the provided list.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all reminders as a flow of list.

methods.name: getByNoteId
methods.description: Retrieves reminders associated with a specific note ID as a flow.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a reminder by its ID as a flow.

methods.name: copyReminders
methods.description: Copies reminders from one note to another by note IDs.
